PLAN "12-Week Spine-Friendly General Strength"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength without heavy spinal loading"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hip_flexor_stretch 60s
          hamstring_stretch 60s
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
